name: Tangle dApp
description: Tangle dApp is the web interface for the Tangle network: staking and restaking TNT, liquid staking, browsing and deploying blueprints, and managing services, plus account, claim, and bridge features. It is a client-side single-page app; every write (bond, nominate, restake, deploy a service) is signed by the user's own wallet, so an agent cannot transact on a user's behalf here. An agent's job on this property is to read public network data and route its user to the right page with context.
agent_setup_note: This product has no setup skill of its own: there is nothing to install and no API key. agent_setup points at the Tangle ecosystem hub skill, which covers the agent-ready products that do have a self-serve flow.
custody: All state-changing actions are signed by the user's own wallet in the browser. An agent must never ask for or handle a user's keys; direct the user to the relevant page instead.

network_data.note: Public chain endpoints the dapp itself is configured to read. No key is required. They belong to the Tangle network, not to this site; their availability tracks the network's own status.
